about: Words said aloud during a take to direct the cut. Each is a word said twice in a row, so it does not turn up in ordinary speech. first-edit/launch listens for them, acts on them, and trims them out of the clips. Add a line to add a cue; 'heard_as' lists other ways the transcriber may write it. 'heard_alone' lists shorter ways that count only when said on their own: straight after a cut cue, or with a pause either side. A lone "best" is a cue; "the best thing is" is not.

cues.means: This scene is finished. Everything said since the last cut is one scene, and each try at it is a clip; the next thing said starts a new scene.
Said once to the director to stop the camera. It only counts as the very last word of a recording, where it is trimmed off; anywhere else it is an ordinary word.
The clip just finished is the best of its scene so far: king of the hill. Say it again after a later take and that one takes over; the earlier one stays in the scene folder as a candidate.
